name: Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
title: Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
headline: SageMaker HyperPod manages NVIDIA Dynamo serving
lede: You can serve large models across multiple nodes with managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference, including KV-aware routing and automatic fault recovery.

effects.effect: Managed serving takes on routing and fault recovery.
Large models gain a managed multi-node serving option.

appearances.title: Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
appearances.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference now supports NVIDIA Dynamo for distributed inference, with multi-node and disaggregated serving, KV-aware routing, and automatic fault recovery. Serve large models across many nodes without building the orchestration layer yourself.
